version.description: event message schema version (required) in SemVer 2.0 format

systemId.description: the system generating the event. The hashtag (#) can be used to separate process and function names. The order should be system#sub1#sub2  (required)

eventType.description: the event type. Event type can be used to filter (required)

sequenceNumber.description: a sequence number used to order events within the same process or thread (optional)

timestamp.description: UTC, ISO-8601 formatted timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ) used to order events within the same process or thread (optional)

info.description: optional information attributes as key, value pairs

uuid_v7.description: a UUID v7 that is the parent id of the event when used to track multiple stages of an event (required)
